## What landed

- **exports** — `spine_export.py`: `evidence_artifacts` emits a per-artifact `captures` JSON history (additive column 12; pre-P36.51 11-col rows degrade to the typed empty state); `_evidence` carries `lane`/`lane_basis`/`part_viii_class`/`upstream` (same `lane_by_source` map as statements) and per-capture `view_original`. `release_pages.evidence_page` renders the K8 §4.2 capture-history table — digest/bytes/media/HTTP/method/classification (synthetic labelled run record)/tier + per-row view-original — plus the S-6 upstream block. `statements.py`: `capture_view_original` (binding-free §5.3 decision) + `raw_href` minting machinery (byte links only where the release serves the object — TX-12 supplies the resolver).
- **api** — `/v1/claim/{id}` returns `artifact_id`, `binding_status`, per-binding `evidence[]` rows and the `provenance` `/v1/evidence` href (`StoredClaim.bindings`; `claim_evidence JOIN evidence_capture`, `binding_status` column-guarded for pre-P32.2 spines). `/v1/evidence` returns `capture_classification` (non-sealed) and the S-6-gated `upstream` block; `source_uri` now publishes only for a full-URL lane — a leak the fix closes (sealed/restricted unchanged). `CaptureMetadata` gains `lane`/`part_viii_class`.
- **web** — `evidence-viewer.ts`: the K8 §4.3 pane union (`text_span | locator_only | metadata_only | run_record`) replaces "non-sealed ⇒ text"; `claimPaneFor` derives binding × lane; `assertClaimView` checks pane vs lane — a lane forbidding bytes never fails the build, a `text_span` pane without bytes still does. `[id].astro` renders all four panes; fixtures cover every kind.
